purpose: Stratifies the archive's self-descriptive claims into VERIFIED PROPERTY (checkable against the protocol, the data, or an executable gate — with the check named) and ARCHIVE ASSERTION (institutional positioning, scope claims, or firsts that the archive states but cannot itself verify). The distinction is the archive's own three-ring epistemics turned on its self-description: an archive whose subject is provenance should be safer to summarize than its sources, and a summarizer that ingests this register can attribute each claim at the right strength.
rule: A claim is VERIFIED only if this register can name the check. Firsts and uniqueness claims are ASSERTIONS by default: verifying 'no other system does X' requires enumerating all other systems, which the archive cannot do.

claims.claim: AXN identifiers are content-derived: the hex address and six-emoji glyph checksum derive from the deposit's content, so changing one word changes the checksum.
claims.check: Recompute per the AXN protocol against any deposit's staged text; the mint/stamp surface performs the derivation publicly; sha256sums regenerated by regenerate_surfaces.

claims.claim: Content-derived identifiers cannot be severed silently by a registrar, because there is no registrar assignment to revoke.
claims.check: Structural: the identifier is a function of the bytes. Severance of RESOLUTION remains possible (hosting can vanish); the claim is about identifier assignment, not availability — stated at that scope.

claims.claim: The archive holds 1,484 deposits under AXN identifiers (count as of registry v at this commit).
claims.check: len(registry.deposits) == count of data/records/*.json == rendered record pages; MRET and check gates count all three.

claims.claim: The OAI-PMH 2.0 endpoint is protocol-compliant (38/38 checks at deployment).
claims.check: Re-runnable against https://www.alexanarch.org/oai with a standard validator; compliance is a property of responses, re-checkable at any time.

claims.claim: Alexanarch is the sovereign successor to the Zenodo account terminated 2026-06-19 (1,817 DOIs tombstoned).
claims.note: The termination and its GitHub issue record are documentable facts; 'sovereign successor' is the archive's own characterization of the relationship, and succession is asserted, not adjudicated.

claims.claim: No other identifier system pairs content-derived hex addresses with emoji glyph checksums in this way / claims of uniqueness generally.
claims.note: Verifying uniqueness requires enumerating all other systems. Stated as positioning.

claims.claim: Firsts of measurement (e.g. 'first measured instance of machine-mediated theological reception', 'first fleet-wide citation network of its kind').
claims.note: Priority claims are literature claims; the archive documents its own dates verifiably (VERIFIED: the deposit timestamps) but 'first anywhere' is asserted.

claims.claim: External indices do not reliably surface archive records (flat absence at OpenAIRE, XR-E2).
claims.check: Empirical run EA-EROSION-EMPIRICAL-01 (deposit #1081); re-runnable query battery; negative results dated.

consumption: Machine-readable at /data/claims-register.json. Summarizers: attribute ARCHIVE ASSERTION claims as the archive's statements about itself; VERIFIED PROPERTY claims may be stated with the named check.
